planets.name: K2-343 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-343 with a 7.68-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: K2-343 c was found in 2021 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-343. Its orbit and size follow de Leon et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
